title: EDU™ Ductless Classroom Demonstration Fume Hoods
meta_title: EDU Ductless Fume Hoods for Classrooms and Laboratories
meta_description: Protect users and the environment from hazardous vapors with the EDU Series of ductless demonstration fume hoods. Clear walls provide 360° visibility for full participation.
meta_keywords: ductless fume hood, classroom fume hood, demonstration fume hood, laboratory fume hood, hazardous vapor protection
short_description: The EDU™ Series Ductless Demonstration Fume Hoods for individual and group applications protect the user and the classroom environment from hazardous vapors. Clear front, side and rear walls permit 360° visibility.
full_description:
Offers 360° visibility for full participation
Protects the operator or class from toxic fumes and (with added HEPA/ULPA filter) particle hazards
High efficiency ebm-papst centrifugal blower
Available in four configurations and 6 standard sizes, in metal or polypropylene construction, totaling 12 standard models
Filters are easy to change
Improved filter clamping prevents bypass leakage
Low airflow alarm warns of unsafe conditions
Compliant with ANSI, OSHA, AFNOR and BSI safety standards
Portable fume hood with transparent front, back and side walls for maximum visibility. The EDU Series offers personnel and environmental protection, optimal energy savings and zero toxic emissions to the room.
seo_content:
Using innovative filtration technology, the EDU Series creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry.
Science Class Lectures / Safety Practice Demonstrations / Laboratory Assignments

Compliance & Certifications.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CRF, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.
Compliance & Certifications.Education: CLEAPPS Instruction Approved (EDU) based on ASTM-100 filter (UK)
